verdict.rationale: Cline Kanban is a first-party web-based task board for running many coding agents in parallel. Each card gets its own isolated git worktree, with auto-commit, dependency chains, and in-card diff review with inline comments. The native app also lets you run agent sessions in any folder from one place. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Kanban multi-session workflow, detail on session monitoring and control (status overview, pause/stop) across sessions.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace

citations.quote: Run many agents in parallel from a web-based task board with per-card worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains.
